newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Int. Factors to raise S$70 mln in FRN.
newsitem.headline: Int. Factors to raise S$70 mln in FRN.

text.p: International Factors (Singapore) Ltd said on Monday it proposed to raise approximately S$70 million through an unsecured issue of floating rate notes due 2002.
The company said in a statement the note issue would be structured as a bought deal with Citicorp Investment Bank (Singapore) Ltd.
The notes, in bearer form and in denominations of S$250,000 each, would have an interest rate of 0.5 percent per annum above the Singapore Interbank Offered Rate for Singapore dollars.
The company said it would use the net proceeds of the issue to finance the acquisition and development of an industrial site in Singapore.
